## Goal
- Fix the IVX chat initial-position defect via inverted FlatList, complete ALL non-device automated QA, deploy owner QA diagnostic panel, and now move iOS QA to real cloud infrastructure (EAS/Maestro, BrowserStack, or GitHub Actions macOS runner)

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT create a new app — `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch, this is the existing IVX Holdings project at `/home/user/rork-app`
- Do NOT return fake progress theater — return real evidence or honest failures
- Do NOT mark a run successful without task-specific evidence
- Do NOT mark iOS BLOCKED only because sandbox has no iPhone — must move to cloud infrastructure
- Do NOT change the chat implementation again unless real device QA finds a defect
- Must use `curl --data-binary @/tmp/payload.json` (NOT `curl -d`) for file commits
- `contentEncoding: 'base64'` with `--data-binary @file` is the proven working commit method
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `action: 'github_commit_file'`, `confirm: true`, `confirmText: 'CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE'`, `input: { path, message, content, contentEncoding }`
- Owner auth: `POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}` → `accessToken` (1620 chars, expires on backend restart)
- Backend hibernates on Render free tier — must ping awake before any API calls
- iOS QA acceptance levels: IOS CODE QA, IOS SIMULATOR QA, IOS REAL CLOUD DEVICE QA, IOS OWNER PHYSICAL DEVICE QA
- Owner requires EAS Workflows + Maestro (Option A) → BrowserStack (Option B) → Mac runner + Xcode (Option C) — do NOT mark BLOCKED unless all three unavailable
